question: How severely flawed can a day and ascendant be for ritual purposes?
premises: A day can be described as fault-rich.
An ascendant can be described as fault-rich.
The faults are said to be many crores in number.
inference: Both day and ascendant may be afflicted by countless faults.
uncertainties: The token meva is unclear in form and function here.
plain_english: A day and an ascendant may be laden with countless faults.
